benefits.name: Airline incidental fee credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $200 per calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Select one qualifying airline (Alaska, American, Delta, Hawaiian, JetBlue, Southwest, United) in your Amex account under Benefits before charging; incidental fees like checked bags, seat fees, and in-flight purchases then credit back automatically. Airline choice can only be changed each January.

tips.text: Airline fee credit workarounds: what still triggers it in 2026: Gift cards, airline tickets, upgrades, and award tickets are explicitly excluded. United TravelBank deposits stopped triggering the credit in February 2026 and the Delta partial-gift-card workaround stopped in spring 2026; sub-$100 Southwest airfare purchases were still reported as reimbursing as of spring 2026.

Airline selection mid-year change via chat: Although the airline choice officially locks after January, cardmembers have reported that Amex chat representatives will change the selected airline mid-year if asked politely.

benefits.name: Hotel credit (Fine Hotels + Resorts / The Hotel Collection)
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $600 per year (up to $300 Jan-Jun and up to $300 Jul-Dec)
benefits.howToUse: Book a prepaid stay through American Express Travel in Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection; The Hotel Collection requires a minimum two-night stay. Unused half-year credit does not roll over.

benefits.name: Uber Cash
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $200 per year ($15 per month, $35 in December)
benefits.howToUse: Add your Platinum Card to your Uber account; the cash loads monthly and can be used for Uber rides or Uber Eats in the U.S. Unused amounts expire at month-end.

benefits.name: Uber One membership credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $120 per calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Pay for an Uber One membership with your Platinum Card and receive statement credits toward the membership cost, subject to auto-renewal.

benefits.name: CLEAR+ membership credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $219 per calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Enroll through your Amex account, then pay for an auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership with the card; the credit matches CLEAR+'s July 2026 price increase to $219.

benefits.name: Digital entertainment credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $300 per year ($25 per month)
benefits.howToUse: Enroll, then pay for eligible subscriptions with the card: Disney+, Disney+ Bundle, ESPN+, Hulu, The New York Times, Peacock, The Wall Street Journal, Paramount+, YouTube Premium, and YouTube TV. Unused monthly amounts expire.

benefits.name: Resy dining credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $400 per year ($100 per quarter)
benefits.howToUse: Enroll, then pay with the card at eligible U.S. Resy restaurants; no reservation is required, and the credit also works on gift cards sold at participating Resy restaurants. Unused quarterly amounts expire.

benefits.name: lululemon credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $300 per year ($75 per quarter)
benefits.howToUse: Enroll, then use the card at U.S. lululemon stores (excluding outlets) or lululemon.com; unused quarterly amounts expire.

benefits.name: Oura Ring credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $200 per calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Enroll, then purchase an Oura Ring on Ouraring.com with the card; the credit applies to hardware only, not the monthly membership.

benefits.name: Equinox credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $300 per calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Enroll, then apply the credit toward an Equinox gym membership or an Equinox+ digital membership, subject to auto-renewal.

benefits.name: SoulCycle at-home bike credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $300 per calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Enroll, maintain an active Equinox+ membership, then charge the full price of a SoulCycle at-home bike in a single transaction with the card; the credit applies to up to 15 bikes per year.

benefits.name: Walmart+ membership credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $155 per year ($12.95 per month plus tax)
benefits.howToUse: Enroll and pay for a Walmart+ monthly membership with the card; Plus Up add-ons are excluded and the membership is subject to auto-renewal.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck application fee credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $120 every 4 years (Global Entry) or up to $85 every 4.5 years (TSA PreCheck)
benefits.howToUse: Charge the application fee to the card and a statement credit posts automatically; the credit can also cover a family member's application since it is not tied to the cardmember's own enrollment.

benefits.name: Centurion Lounge access
benefits.amountDisplay: Unlimited visits
benefits.howToUse: Show the card, a same-day boarding pass, and a government ID. Since July 8, 2026, guests must travel on the same flight as the cardmember and layover access is capped at 5 hours before the connecting flight (3 hours at origin). Guests cost $50 each ($30 for children 2-17); spending $75,000 on the card in a calendar year unlocks two complimentary guests per visit.

benefits.name: Delta Sky Club access
benefits.amountDisplay: 10 visits per year
benefits.howToUse: Present the card with a same-day Delta-operated or Delta-marketed flight boarding pass (basic economy excluded); access is cardmember-only with no free guests. Spending $75,000 in a calendar year unlocks unlimited visits, and all Sky Club entries within a 24-hour window count as a single visit.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select membership
benefits.amountDisplay: Unlimited lounge visits
benefits.howToUse: This is the most commonly missed benefit because it is not automatic: enroll through your Amex account first to receive the Priority Pass card. Enroll even before any trip so it is ready to use.

benefits.name: Plaza Premium, Escape, and Airspace lounges
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary access
benefits.howToUse: Included in the Global Lounge Collection; present the Platinum Card and a same-day boarding pass for entry at participating locations. Lufthansa lounge access ended October 1, 2026.

benefits.name: Hilton Honors Gold status
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary mid-tier elite status
benefits.howToUse: Enroll in your Amex account under Benefits; status is maintained as long as the card account remains open.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary mid-tier elite status
benefits.howToUse: Enroll in your Amex account under Benefits; status is maintained as long as the card account remains open.

benefits.name: Leaders Club Sterling status (Leading Hotels of the World)
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary Sterling tier status
benefits.howToUse: Enroll in your Amex account; Sterling status adds a 5% points bonus on qualifying stays and pre-arrival upgrades at Leading Hotels of the World properties.

benefits.name: Car rental elite status
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary elite tiers
benefits.howToUse: Enroll in each program through your Amex account to receive Hertz Gold Plus Rewards President's Circle, Avis Preferred Plus, and National Emerald Club Executive status.

benefits.name: Fine Hotels + Resorts program perks
benefits.amountDisplay: Room upgrade, $100 property credit, breakfast, 4 PM checkout
benefits.howToUse: Book any Fine Hotels + Resorts stay through Amex Travel to receive a room upgrade when available, daily breakfast for two, noon check-in when available, guaranteed 4 PM late checkout, and a $100 credit toward eligible on-property charges; the credit stacks with the semi-annual prepaid hotel credit.

benefits.name: International Airline Program
benefits.amountDisplay: Discounted premium-cabin international fares
benefits.howToUse: Book qualifying international itineraries through Amex Travel or a Platinum Travel advisor to access discounted business- and first-class fares (and select premium economy/economy fares) for the cardmember and up to seven companions on the same itinerary.

benefits.name: Platinum concierge
benefits.amountDisplay: 24/7 concierge service
benefits.howToUse: Call or message the concierge for restaurant reservations, event and show tickets, travel research, and sourcing hard-to-find items; treat it as a time-saving assistant rather than a way to get otherwise-unavailable inventory.

benefits.name: Trip cancellation and interruption insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10,000 per covered trip; up to $20,000 per eligible card per 12 consecutive months
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the entire round-trip fare with the card; non-refundable expenses are reimbursed for covered reasons. Coverage is provided by New Hampshire Insurance Company, an AIG company.

benefits.name: Trip delay insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500 per covered trip; maximum 2 claims per eligible card per 12 consecutive months
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the entire round-trip fare with the card; delays of more than 6 hours for a covered reason qualify for reimbursement of additional expenses charged to the card.

benefits.name: Baggage insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $3,000 per person (up to $2,000 for checked baggage)
benefits.howToUse: Charge the entire fare to the card; coverage applies to lost, damaged, or stolen baggage on a common carrier, with caps on high-value items. New York residents have different per-bag limits.

benefits.name: Car rental loss and damage insurance (secondary)
benefits.amountDisplay: Secondary coverage up to $75,000
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the entire rental with the card and decline the rental agency's collision coverage; coverage applies worldwide except Australia, Italy, and New Zealand, for rentals up to 30 days.

benefits.name: Premium Car Rental Protection (optional add-on)
benefits.amountDisplay: Primary coverage (enrollment + per-rental fee applies)
benefits.howToUse: Enroll the card once in Amex's Premium Car Rental Protection program; you are then charged a flat fee per rental for primary coverage (higher limits, up to 42 days, and medical coverage) instead of relying on the included secondary coverage.

benefits.name: Purchase protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10,000 per occurrence; up to $50,000 per account per calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Items purchased with the card are covered for 120 days (90 days in New York) against accidental damage, theft, or loss; file a claim with Amex within the coverage window.

benefits.name: Return protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $300 per item; up to $1,000 per account per year
benefits.howToUse: If a merchant will not accept a return within 90 days of purchase, Amex may refund the purchase price; file a claim and ship the item if requested.

benefits.name: Extended warranty
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10,000 per item; up to $50,000 per account per calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Automatically adds up to one additional year to eligible manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less on items purchased with the card.

benefits.name: Cell phone protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $800 per claim ($50 deductible); maximum 2 claims per 12-month period
benefits.howToUse: Pay your monthly cell phone bill with the Platinum Card to activate coverage against damage or theft of the phone listed on the bill.

benefits.name: Premium Global Assist hotline
benefits.amountDisplay: 24/7 emergency coordination
benefits.howToUse: Call the hotline when traveling for medical, legal, or emergency referrals; emergency medical evacuation can be provided at no cost if coordinated through and approved by the hotline.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% foreign transaction fees
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on all international purchases charged to the card.

benefits.name: Amex Offers
benefits.amountDisplay: Varies by offer
benefits.howToUse: Activate targeted offers in your Amex account or app before spending at the merchant; since July 1, 2026, Amex has added Platinum-exclusive Amex Offers at top retailers following the retirement of the Saks credit.

benefits.name: $300 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.amountDisplay: $300 per membership year
benefits.howToUse: Fully automatic — no enrollment. Statement credit applies to virtually any travel purchase charged to the card, including airfare, hotels, rental cars, transit, parking, and tolls.

benefits.name: The Edit by Chase Travel Hotel Credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500 per year (two $250 credits)
benefits.howToUse: Book a prepaid stay of at least 2 nights at The Edit luxury hotels via Chase Travel and pay with the Reserve card; statement credits post automatically.

tips.text: Double-Dip Hotel Credit Stack ($500 off one stay): If a property appears in BOTH The Edit and the select-partner list (e.g., IHG, Omni, Virgin), a single prepaid 2+ night booking triggers both the $250 Edit credit and the one-time $250 hotels credit simultaneously. Expires Dec. 31, 2026.

benefits.name: One-Time $250 Chase Travel Hotels Credit (2026 only)
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $250
benefits.howToUse: Book a prepaid 2+ night stay at IHG, Montage, Pendry, Omni, Virgin, Minor, or Pan Pacific hotels via Chase Travel before Dec. 31, 2026 and pay with the card.

benefits.name: Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables Dining Credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $150 each Jan–Jun and Jul–Dec ($300/year)
benefits.howToUse: Pay with the Reserve card at participating Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables restaurants — no OpenTable reservation or prepayment required. Note the participating restaurant list is small and centered on major cities, so check it first.

benefits.name: StubHub & viagogo Ticket Credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $150 each Jan–Jun and Jul–Dec ($300/year), through Dec. 31, 2027
benefits.howToUse: Activate once in the Chase benefits hub BEFORE buying, then pay with the Reserve card at stubhub.com, viagogo.com, or their apps. Gift card purchases are excluded and will not trigger the credit.

benefits.name: DoorDash DashPass + Monthly Promos
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary DashPass plus up to $35/month ($15 any-order promo + two $10 non-restaurant promos = $420/year); DashPass and promos run through Dec. 31, 2029
benefits.howToUse: Activate DashPass in the Chase benefits hub, set the Reserve as your default DoorDash payment method, and manually toggle each 'Chase monthly benefit' promo ON at checkout — they are in-app promos, not automatic statement credits. Only one DashPass can be active at a time per DoorDash account.

benefits.name: Lyft In-App Credit + 5x Points
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10/month in-app credit ($120/year), through Sept. 30, 2027; also 5x points on Lyft rides through the same date
benefits.howToUse: Add the Reserve card DIRECTLY in the Lyft app as your payment method — Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal are explicitly excluded and paying through them will not trigger the credit. Credit applies automatically to the subtotal of Standard, Extra Comfort, XL, Black, or Black SUV rides; fees, taxes, tips, gift cards, Wait & Save, bikes, and scooters are excluded. Use it or lose it each month. This is a Sapphire Reserve perk (Chase limits it to Reserve/J.P. Morgan Reserve cards — not Preferred).

benefits.name: Peloton Membership Credit + 10x Equipment Earnings
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10/month statement credit ($120/year) on Peloton memberships, through Dec. 31, 2027; plus 10x points (up to 50,000 pts) on Peloton equipment/accessory purchases over $150 through Dec. 31, 2027
benefits.howToUse: One-time activation in the Chase benefits hub, then set the Reserve as the default payment method on an eligible membership (All-Access, App+, App One, Guide, Rental, or Strength+). No Peloton machine required for the membership credit.

benefits.name: Apple TV+ & Apple Music Subscriptions
benefits.amountDisplay: $288/year value in complimentary subscriptions, through June 22, 2027
benefits.howToUse: In your Chase account, go to Card Benefits and click 'Activate now' under each Apple perk to link your Apple ID — one-time activation per service. Existing paid subscriptions auto-suspend when activated. If you have an Apple One bundle instead, you get a $7.50/month discount on it.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS Credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $120 every 4 years
benefits.howToUse: Charge the application fee to the Reserve card — it is automatically reimbursed as a statement credit. The fee can be for anyone, not just the cardholder.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status
benefits.amountDisplay: Mid-tier IHG Platinum Elite through Dec. 31, 2027 (60% bonus points, room upgrades, late checkout, welcome amenity)
benefits.howToUse: Not automatic — you must link your Chase and IHG accounts via the Chase benefits hub to activate; activation can take up to 3 weeks.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.amountDisplay: Unlimited access to 1,300+ airport lounges worldwide for cardholder + 2 guests
benefits.howToUse: Enroll for the Priority Pass Select membership once through Chase; present your Priority Pass card in the app. Restaurant access is NOT included in the included membership.

benefits.name: Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club Access
benefits.amountDisplay: Access to Chase Sapphire Lounges for cardholder + 2 guests (additional guests $27 each)
benefits.howToUse: Present the Reserve card at any Chase Sapphire Lounge. Authorized users get their own access + 2 guests.

benefits.name: Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounge Access
benefits.amountDisplay: Access to 20 Maple Leaf Lounges/Cafés at 16 airports for cardholder + 1 guest
benefits.howToUse: No enrollment — just present your physical Reserve card and a same-day boarding pass for a flight operated by Air Canada or any Star Alliance airline. Guest costs ~$59 USD equivalent.

benefits.name: Reserve Travel Designers
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary custom trip planning (no agency fees)
benefits.howToUse: Primary cardmembers log into the Chase Travel portal and open the 'Reserve Travel Designers' section to chat with or contact a destination-expert travel designer (powered by Valerie Wilson Travel).

benefits.name: Points Boost Redemption
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to 2 cents per point on select premium flights/hotels booked through Chase Travel; 1 cent per point on standard bookings
benefits.howToUse: Redeem points directly in the Chase Travel portal — Points Boost rates appear automatically on eligible premium bookings.

benefits.name: $75,000 Annual Spend Unlock
benefits.amountDisplay: $500 Southwest Airlines Chase Travel credit + $250 Shops at Chase credit + IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite + World of Hyatt Explorist + Southwest Rapid Rewards A-List status (valid rest of qualifying year + following year)
benefits.howToUse: Spend $75,000 in a calendar year on the Reserve — perks unlock automatically once the threshold is hit.

benefits.name: Travel Insurance & Protections Package
benefits.amountDisplay: Trip cancellation/interruption up to $10,000/person and $20,000/trip; trip delay up to $500/traveler after 6+ hours or overnight stay; primary rental car CDW up to $75,000; baggage delay up to $100/day for 5 days; lost luggage up to $3,000/person; travel accident up to $1,000,000; emergency evacuation up to $100,000; emergency medical/dental up to $2,500 (100+ miles from home); roadside assistance up to $50/incident, 4x per year
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the trip (or purchase) with the Reserve card or Ultimate Rewards points; decline the rental company's CDW for rental coverage. Note: NY residents with a personal auto policy get secondary (not primary) coverage on domestic rentals.

benefits.name: Purchase Protections
benefits.amountDisplay: Extended warranty (+1 year on eligible US warranties of 3 years or less); purchase protection 120 days against damage/theft (up to $10,000/claim, $50,000/year); return protection up to $500/item, $1,000/year within 90 days
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on items purchased with the Reserve card — file a claim with the card's benefit administrator when an event occurs.

benefits.name: Hertz Gold Plus Rewards Five Star Status
benefits.amountDisplay: Mid-tier Hertz Five Star (better car selection, improved points earning, free additional drivers)
benefits.howToUse: Enroll once through the Visa Infinite benefit link or Hertz with your Reserve card details.

benefits.name: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% FX fee on international purchases
benefits.howToUse: Automatic — use the card abroad normally and earn 8x/4x/3x category rates with no surcharge.

benefits.name: Authorized User Lounge Access
benefits.amountDisplay: $195 per authorized user per year; AU gets own Sapphire Lounge + Priority Pass access with 2 guests (no IHG Platinum status)
benefits.howToUse: Add an authorized user in your Chase account; they receive their own card and lounge access after Priority Pass enrollment.

benefits.name: Welcome Bonus
benefits.amountDisplay: 100,000 Ultimate Rewards points after $6,000 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening
benefits.howToUse: Meet the minimum spend within 3 months of account opening — points post after the qualifying billing cycle. (A limited-time 150,000-point offer ended earlier in 2026.)

benefits.name: Welcome bonus
benefits.amountDisplay: 75,000 bonus points after spending $5,000 in the first 3 months from account opening
benefits.howToUse: Apply and meet the minimum spend within 3 months of account opening; points post to your Ultimate Rewards balance. (A limited 100,000-point offer ran June 15-July 30, 2026 and has since reverted to 75,000.)

benefits.name: $100 Chase Travel hotel credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $100 in statement credits each account anniversary year
benefits.howToUse: Book one or more prepaid hotel stays through Chase Travel and pay with the card; the credit applies automatically with no enrollment. Note it follows your cardmember year, not the calendar year, and the rebated $100 does not earn rewards points.

benefits.name: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $120 statement credit every four years
benefits.howToUse: Charge the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee to your Sapphire Preferred; Chase reimburses it as a statement credit automatically every four years. Added with the June 15, 2026 refresh.

benefits.name: Complimentary Apple TV subscription
benefits.amountDisplay: 12 months free ($156 value)
benefits.howToUse: Activate the offer by December 31, 2026 through the Chase benefits/partner page; cancel before it renews to avoid being billed. One-time offer added with the June 2026 refresh.

benefits.name: DoorDash DashPass membership
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary for a minimum of 1 year (~$120/year value)
benefits.howToUse: Add your Sapphire Preferred as the payment method in your DoorDash account and activate the complimentary DashPass by December 31, 2027. You get $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees on eligible DoorDash/Caviar orders; after the free year you auto-enroll at the prevailing monthly rate, so set a reminder.

benefits.name: DoorDash $10 monthly non-restaurant promo
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10 off per calendar month (up to $120/year)
benefits.howToUse: With an active DashPass membership, you get up to $10 off at checkout on one grocery, convenience, or retail (non-restaurant) DoorDash order each month. It does not roll over and does not apply to restaurant food delivery.

benefits.name: Instacart+ trial and $10 monthly Instacart credit
benefits.amountDisplay: 3-month complimentary Instacart+ membership plus $10/month Instacart credit
benefits.howToUse: Enroll through the Chase/Instacart offer page; the membership trial and monthly credit both end December 31, 2027. Use the $10 monthly credit on grocery delivery each month before it expires.

benefits.name: 5x on Lyft rides (no Lyft in-app credit on Preferred)
benefits.amountDisplay: 5x total Ultimate Rewards points per dollar on Lyft through 9/30/27
benefits.howToUse: Pay for Lyft rides with your Sapphire Preferred; 5x posts automatically with no enrollment. Confirmed: the $10/month Lyft in-app credit and Lyft Pink membership are Sapphire Reserve-only; Sapphire Preferred gets the 5x earn only.

benefits.name: 5x on Peloton purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 5x total points on eligible Peloton equipment and accessory purchases over $150 through 12/31/27
benefits.howToUse: Pay with your Sapphire Preferred on eligible Peloton equipment and accessories totaling over $150; the bonus points post automatically.

benefits.name: Bonus earning categories
benefits.amountDisplay: 5x Chase Travel; 3x dining, streaming, online grocery, gas/EV charging, vacation rentals (Airbnb, Vrbo); 2x all other travel; 1x everything else; 5x Lyft through 9/30/27
benefits.howToUse: Just spend with the card; no enrollment needed. Gas/EV charging and vacation-rental 3x were added June 15, 2026. Online grocery excludes Target, Walmart, and wholesale clubs.

benefits.name: 25% more value on Chase Travel redemptions + Points Boost
benefits.amountDisplay: Points worth 1.25 cents each on Chase Travel; Points Boost gives up to 50% more on select hotels/flights and 75% more on select premium-cabin flights
benefits.howToUse: Book through the Chase Travel portal for the automatic 1.25x redemption value, and look for Points Boost badges on eligible flights and hotels for even higher per-point value. Transfers to airline/hotel partners often beat both.

benefits.name: Points transfers to 14 travel partners (Hyatt now 4:3)
benefits.amountDisplay: 1:1 transfers to 13 partners; World of Hyatt transfers at 4:3 for Sapphire Preferred
benefits.howToUse: Link your loyalty accounts in the Ultimate Rewards portal and transfer points online; most transfers post quickly. Note the Hyatt ratio dropped from 1:1 to 4:3 effective June 15, 2026 for new applicants and October 1, 2026 for existing cardmembers (Reserve keeps 1:1).

benefits.name: Trip cancellation and interruption insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10,000 per covered traveler, $20,000 per trip
benefits.howToUse: Charge the trip's prepaid nonrefundable costs (tours, hotels, flights) to the card; if illness, weather, or another covered reason cancels the trip, file a claim with documentation. Even award travelers may be covered if qualifying taxes and fees were charged to the card.

benefits.name: Trip delay reimbursement
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500 per ticket for delays over 12 hours or requiring an overnight stay
benefits.howToUse: Charge the fare to the card; if delayed 12+ hours or overnight, keep receipts for meals, lodging, and transportation and file a claim. Coverage extends to you and covered family/companions.

benefits.name: Baggage delay insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $100 per day for up to 5 days for bags delayed more than 6 hours
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the flight with the card; if your checked bag is delayed over 6 hours, buy essentials like toiletries and clothing and file a claim with airline documentation of the delay and your receipts.

benefits.name: Lost luggage reimbursement
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $3,000 per passenger
benefits.howToUse: Charge the trip to the card; if the carrier loses your checked or carry-on luggage, file a claim. You'll need documentation and original receipts for items costing over $25, which makes claiming full value harder than it sounds.

benefits.name: Primary auto rental collision damage waiver
benefits.amountDisplay: Primary coverage for rental car theft and physical damage worldwide
benefits.howToUse: Charge the full rental to the card and decline the rental agency's CDW; coverage is primary so you don't involve your personal auto insurance. It also extends to authorized users renting in their own names.

benefits.name: Emergency evacuation and transportation coverage
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $100,000 for emergency evacuation and transportation
benefits.howToUse: New with the June 2026 refresh: if a covered traveler is injured or becomes sick during a trip 100+ miles from home and requires emergency evacuation, medical services and transportation are covered up to $100,000. Charge trip costs to the card and file a claim.

benefits.name: Travel accident insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Accidental death and dismemberment coverage; benefit varies by covered loss
benefits.howToUse: Applies automatically when common-carrier travel (airlines, trains, buses) is purchased with the card. Check your guide to benefits for coverage tiers.

benefits.name: Purchase protection
benefits.amountDisplay: 120 days from purchase; up to $500 per claim and $50,000 per account per year
benefits.howToUse: Buy the item with the card; if it's damaged or stolen within 120 days, file a claim with proof of purchase. Also includes zero-liability protection against unauthorized charges.

benefits.name: Extended warranty protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Adds one additional year to eligible U.S. manufacturer's warranties
benefits.howToUse: Buy the item with the card; coverage automatically extends eligible warranties of 3 years or less by one year. File a claim with Chase's benefits administrator with the original receipt and warranty documentation.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 foreign transaction fee
benefits.howToUse: Use the card anywhere internationally; Chase adds no markup on foreign-currency purchases.

benefits.name: Free authorized users
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 per authorized user
benefits.howToUse: Add authorized users in your Chase account at no cost; they earn points on their purchases into your account and are eligible for primary rental car coverage when renting in their own name.

benefits.name: 3x Ultimate Rewards on business categories
benefits.amountDisplay: 3x on first $150,000 in combined purchases per account anniversary year (travel; shipping; internet, cable & phone services; social media/search engine advertising), then 1x
benefits.howToUse: Spend in eligible categories on the card; 3x posts automatically up to the cap, 1x after. Points are fully transferable Ultimate Rewards even without a Sapphire card.

benefits.name: Welcome bonus
benefits.amountDisplay: 100,000 bonus points after spending $8,000 in the first 3 months from account opening
benefits.howToUse: Meet the $8,000 spend within 3 months of account opening; bonus posts automatically. Points worth 1¢ cash, up to 1.75¢ in Chase Travel, or up to ~2¢+ via transfer partners.

benefits.name: 5x on Lyft rides
benefits.amountDisplay: 5x points per $1 on Lyft rides through Sept. 30, 2027
benefits.howToUse: Book qualifying Lyft rides in the Lyft mobile app and pay with the card; 5x posts automatically through Sept. 30, 2027.

benefits.name: DashPass membership + $10/month DoorDash non-restaurant promo (manual promo, not a statement credit)
benefits.amountDisplay: $10 off one eligible non-restaurant DoorDash order per calendar month; complimentary DashPass membership for 12+ months (activate by Dec. 31, 2027)
benefits.howToUse: Add your Ink Business Preferred as the default payment method in DoorDash/Caviar and click the DashPass activation button by Dec. 31, 2027. Each month, at checkout select the $10 non-restaurant promo from your promotion wallet (or when prompted) and pay with your Ink Business Preferred — it does NOT auto-apply as a statement credit. Unused promos do not roll over; fees, taxes, and gratuity are excluded.

benefits.name: Primary auto rental collision coverage
benefits.amountDisplay: Primary CDW for theft/collision damage on business-purpose rentals in the US and abroad (TPG cites up to $60,000 reimbursement; eligible vehicles MSRP ≤ $125,000)
benefits.howToUse: Decline the rental agency's collision insurance, charge the entire rental cost to the card, and rent for a business purpose to get primary coverage in the US; coverage is primary for eligible rentals outside the US.

benefits.name: Cell phone protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $1,000 per claim for theft or damage (max 3 claims per 12-month period; $100 deductible per claim)
benefits.howToUse: Pay your monthly wireless bill with the card; you and employees listed on the bill are covered. Older guides cited $600/claim — current 2026 terms are $1,000/claim.

benefits.name: Purchase protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10,000 per claim and $50,000 per account for items damaged or stolen within 120 days of purchase
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the eligible item with the card; file a claim with the benefit administrator within 120 days of purchase for damage or theft.

benefits.name: Extended warranty protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Adds one extra year to US manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less (up to $10,000 per claim, $50,000 per account)
benefits.howToUse: Buy the item with the card and keep the original warranty documentation; the extension applies automatically to eligible warranties of ≤3 years.

benefits.name: Trip cancellation/interruption insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $5,000 per covered traveler and $10,000 per trip for prepaid, nonrefundable travel expenses
benefits.howToUse: Charge the travel expenses to the card; if the trip is canceled or cut short for a covered reason (illness, severe weather, etc.), file a claim with receipts.

benefits.name: Trip delay reimbursement
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500 per ticket for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed 12+ hours or requires an overnight stay
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the airfare with the card; save receipts for reasonable expenses (meals, lodging) during a qualifying delay and file a claim.

benefits.name: Baggage delay and lost luggage insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: $100 per day for up to 5 days for essentials when baggage is delayed 6+ hours; up to $3,000 per traveler for lost/damaged/stolen checked or carry-on baggage
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the trip with the card; keep receipts for essential purchases during the delay and file a claim with the benefit administrator.

benefits.name: Travel accident insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500,000 accidental death or dismemberment coverage on air, bus, train, or cruise transportation
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the transportation with the card; coverage applies automatically on eligible tickets.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% foreign transaction fee on international purchases
benefits.howToUse: Use the card abroad or for foreign-currency online purchases; no fee is added and you earn 3x on travel spend.

benefits.name: Free employee cards with individual spending limits
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 for additional employee cards
benefits.howToUse: Request employee cards in your Chase business account; set individual spending limits for each card for expense control.

benefits.name: Roadside dispatch and travel/emergency assistance
benefits.amountDisplay: Roadside dispatch at pre-negotiated per-service fees (not free towing)
benefits.howToUse: Call the number on the back of the card for roadside help; services (towing, jump-start, tire change, lockout) are billed at pre-negotiated rates.

benefits.name: World of Hyatt transfer ratio change flag (Oct 1, 2026)
benefits.amountDisplay: 4:3 (1,000 Ultimate Rewards → 750 World of Hyatt points) effective Oct. 1, 2026 for new and existing cardholders
benefits.howToUse: If you value Hyatt transfers, note that Ink Business Preferred moves off the 1:1 Hyatt ratio on Oct. 1, 2026; all other Chase transfer partners remain 1:1. Sapphire Reserve for Business keeps 1:1 Hyatt.

benefits.name: Business card does not add to Chase 5/24 count
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 — card approval still requires being under 5/24, but the new account does not increase your 5/24 count
benefits.howToUse: If under 5/24, apply knowing the Ink Business Preferred won't consume a 5/24 slot since it doesn't report to personal credit bureaus.

cards.canonicalName: Delta SkyMiles Reserve American Express Card

benefits.name: Delta Sky Club access
benefits.amountDisplay: 15 Visits per Medallion Year (Feb 1–Jan 31); unlimited Visits after $75,000 in calendar-year card spend
benefits.howToUse: Show your card and same-day Delta boarding pass at the club; track remaining visits in the Amex app. Basic Economy tickets are excluded. Extra visits cost $50 per person ($25 at Grab and Go locations).

tips.text: Sky Club Visit mechanics and guest-pass strategy: Plan multi-club trips (e.g., LAX–MSP–ORD in one day) to burn a single Visit. Use the 4 annual guest passes for companions; after they're gone, guests cost $50 per visit ($25 at Grab and Go).

benefits.name: Centurion Lounge access when flying Delta
benefits.amountDisplay: Unlimited cardmember access; up to 2 guests at $50/adult and $30/child (2–17) per visit; Escape Lounges also included
benefits.howToUse: Book your Delta flight with your Reserve card and bring your same-day Delta boarding pass to any U.S. or international Centurion Lounge. Guests must be on a same-day Delta flight.

benefits.name: Annual companion certificate
benefits.amountDisplay: One buy-one-get-one round trip per year in Delta First, Delta Comfort+, Premium Select, or Main Cabin; companion pays only taxes/fees of $22–$250
benefits.howToUse: Issued each year at card renewal (not in year one); redeem online at delta.com for U.S. (incl. Hawaii/Alaska), Mexico, Caribbean, and Central America routes. Basic Economy primary fares are ineligible.

tips.text: Companion certificate fare-class and expiration strategy: Check fare-class availability before buying your ticket — if Z/I or L/U/T/X/V inventory is gone, the cert won't attach. Certificates arrive at your renewal month with ~14 months validity; target high-fare First Class transcons or Hawaii, and set a reminder because Delta grants zero extensions (FlyerTalk data point).

benefits.name: MQD Headstart
benefits.amountDisplay: $2,500 Medallion Qualification Dollars deposited each Medallion Qualification Year
benefits.howToUse: Automatic — the MQDs post to the SkyMiles account linked to the card each qualification year, no enrollment needed. Multiple eligible cards each contribute $2,500.

benefits.name: MQD Boost
benefits.amountDisplay: $1 MQD for every $10 in eligible purchases; no published annual cap
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on eligible purchases charged to the card. MQDs are counted per card — $5 on two different cards earns nothing, but $10 on one card earns $1 MQD.

tips.text: MQD Boost counting and exclusions: Put Resy dining and rideshare spend on the card — they double-dip (credit + MQDs). Don't manufacture spend with gift cards or Venmo/P2P; Amex excludes fees, interest, cash advances, balance transfers, gift cards, prepaid reloads, cash equivalents, and person-to-person transactions from eligible purchases.

benefits.name: Delta Stays statement credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $200 per calendar year on prepaid hotels and vacation rentals booked through Delta Stays
benefits.howToUse: Book at Delta Stays on delta.com, select a prepaid ('pay now') rate — many are refundable — and pay with your Reserve card. Credit usually posts within days.

tips.text: Delta Stays credit stacking and multi-card strategy: Before booking, check Amex Offers for a Delta Stays spend bonus and stack it on top of the automatic $200 credit — TPG reported up to $370 back combined. Holding both personal and business Delta cards multiplies the credit across cards.

benefits.name: Resy dining credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $20 per month ($240 per year) at qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants
benefits.howToUse: Enroll in Amex Offers under your account, then pay with the Reserve card at any U.S. restaurant live on the Resy platform. Unused credit does not roll over month to month.

benefits.name: Rideshare credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10 per month ($120 per year) on Uber, Lyft, Curb, Revel, and Alto purchases in the U.S.
benefits.howToUse: Enroll in Amex Offers, then pay for actual U.S. rides with the card. Credit is use-it-or-lose-it each month and usually posts within about two weeks.

tips.text: Rideshare credit quirks: Enroll in Amex Offers first, then take real Uber/Lyft/Curb/Revel/Alto rides. Don't preload Uber Cash expecting the credit (it codes as a wallet load, not a ride); Lyft Cash loads have been reported to work only at $25+.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $120 toward Global Entry or up to $85 toward TSA PreCheck every 4 years
benefits.howToUse: Charge the Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee to the card and Amex issues a statement credit automatically; no enrollment needed.

benefits.name: Free checked bags
benefits.amountDisplay: First checked bag free worldwide plus a second checked bag free on domestic U.S. flights, for the cardmember and up to 8 companions on the same reservation
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when your SkyMiles number is on a Delta reservation — you do not need to pay with the card. Bag weight/size limits apply.

benefits.name: Priority boarding
benefits.amountDisplay: Zone 5 priority boarding on Delta flights
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when your SkyMiles number is attached to the reservation; board with Zone 5 ahead of general boarding.

benefits.name: 20% back on Delta inflight purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 20% statement credit on eligible inflight food, beverages, and audio headsets (Wi-Fi excluded)
benefits.howToUse: Pay for inflight purchases with the Reserve card; the 20% comes back automatically as a statement credit.

benefits.name: TakeOff 15 — 15% off award travel
benefits.amountDisplay: 15% discount on award pricing for Delta-operated flights (not partner-operated flights or taxes/fees)
benefits.howToUse: Book with SkyMiles on delta.com or the Fly Delta app; the discount applies automatically at checkout when the card is linked to your SkyMiles account.

benefits.name: Complimentary upgrade priority
benefits.amountDisplay: Upgrade-list priority behind Medallion members — Reserve cardmembers rank ahead of Platinum cardmembers and ahead of Medallion-free travelers
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when your SkyMiles number is on an eligible paid ticket (Main Cabin or higher): eligible for complimentary upgrades to Delta One (within the 50 U.S. states), First Class, and Comfort+, subject to availability.

benefits.name: Hertz President's Circle status
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary Hertz President's Circle status with guaranteed upgrades and a wider car selection
benefits.howToUse: Add your Hertz Gold Plus Rewards account number to your SkyMiles profile and enroll in the promotion at delta.com/hertz. Status is active as long as the card is open.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500 per covered trip for delays of 6+ hours (limited claims per year)
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the round-trip ticket with the card; file a claim with Amex for covered expenses like meals and lodging incurred during a 6+ hour delay.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation / Interruption Insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10,000 per covered trip
benefits.howToUse: Charge the full trip cost to the card; if the trip is cancelled or interrupted for a covered reason (e.g., illness, severe weather), file a claim with Amex.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $1,250 per person for carry-on and up to $500 per person for checked baggage on lost, damaged, or stolen bags
benefits.howToUse: Charge the trip's common-carrier fare (plane, train, ship, or bus) to the card; coverage is in excess of what the carrier pays. File a claim with Amex after reporting the loss to the carrier.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $1,000 per covered item for accidental damage, theft, or loss within 90 days of purchase
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the item in full with the card and file a claim with Amex within 90 days of the purchase date; per Amex benefit terms and exclusions.

benefits.name: Return Protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $300 per item and $1,000 per year for eligible items the store won't take back, within 90 days of purchase
benefits.howToUse: Charge the item to the card; if the merchant refuses the return within 90 days, Amex may refund you through Return Protection (not available on all items or all card products — Reserve carries it).

benefits.name: Extended Warranty
benefits.amountDisplay: Adds up to 1 year to the original manufacturer's warranty on warranties of 5 years or less
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the item with the card and the extra year is automatic; file a claim with Amex if the item breaks after the manufacturer warranty expires.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $800 per claim ($50 deductible), max 2 claims per 12 months, for damaged or stolen phones
benefits.howToUse: Pay your monthly cell phone bill with the Reserve card in the most recent billing period, then file a claim with Amex if a covered phone on that bill is damaged or stolen.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $75,000 for eligible rental-vehicle damage or theft; primary coverage outside the U.S., secondary in the U.S.
benefits.howToUse: Charge the entire rental to the card and decline the rental company's collision waiver; file a claim with Amex if the vehicle is damaged or stolen.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% foreign transaction fees on all international purchases
benefits.howToUse: Automatic — no enrollment needed; use the card abroad or on foreign-currency purchases without the usual ~2.7% surcharge.

benefits.name: Mileage earning rates
benefits.amountDisplay: 3X miles per dollar on Delta purchases; 1X on all other eligible purchases
benefits.howToUse: Use the card directly with Delta for flights and extras to get 3X; all other spend earns 1X automatically.

cards.annualFeeDisplay: $0 (card itself has no annual fee; requires active Robinhood Gold membership at $5/month or $50/year)

benefits.name: 3% flat cash back on all eligible purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 3 points per $1 (worth 3% of spend), uncapped, no categories, no quarterly activation
benefits.howToUse: Use the card for any purchase; points accrue automatically. An active paid annual Robinhood Gold membership is required to earn at this rate — the free 30-day Gold trial does not qualify.

tips.text: No penalty APR, no overlimit fee, no minimum interest charge: These charges are not part of the card's terms per the official Rates and Fees table (updated Jul 1, 2026).

Redeem points for upgraded card designs: Accumulate points from card spend, then redeem them in the credit card app's Rewards tab toward the card upgrade tier you want; upgrades are a status/status-symbol perk, not cash value.

Points clawback and rescission rules (things that break the 3%): Pay at least the minimum by the due date; avoid manufactured spending, gift-card reselling, business-type transactions, or opening accounts just to game rewards — Robinhood may suspend accrual, take back points, or close the card for fraud, abuse, or misuse under the Rewards Program Rules.
Ineligible purchases earn no points: No enrollment — the exclusions apply automatically per the card terms. Returns also reverse the points originally earned on the refunded purchase.

Points forfeiture on account closure: Redeem any outstanding points before voluntarily closing the account or cancelling Gold; if the program itself were terminated, you would get 45 days' notice and 45 days to redeem.

No sign-up bonus or 0% intro APR: The card's value is entirely in ongoing rewards — unlike most competing cash-back cards, there is no upfront bonus for new cardholders and no 0% introductory period for carrying balances (APR up to ~29.99–33% applies).

benefits.name: Cash-back payout via brokerage deposit
benefits.amountDisplay: Points redeem at 1 cent each when deposited into a Robinhood brokerage account (full 3% effective rate)
benefits.howToUse: In the Robinhood credit card app (separate from the investing app), redeem points to your brokerage account, then invest, earn sweep interest, or withdraw. Statement-credit redemptions are worth only 0.7 cents per point, dropping the effective rate to ~2.1%.

benefits.name: 5% cash back on Robinhood travel portal bookings
benefits.amountDisplay: 5 points per $1 (5%) on flights, hotels, and rental cars booked through the Robinhood travel portal
benefits.howToUse: Book travel inside the Robinhood travel portal (administered by Ascenda) and pay with the Gold Card. Price-compare first — portal prices can exceed booking direct.

benefits.name: No annual card fee / Robinhood Gold membership required
benefits.amountDisplay: Card fee $0; Robinhood Gold membership $5/month ($60/year) or $50/year if prepaid annually
benefits.howToUse: If you are not a Gold member at application, approving the card also confirms the Gold upgrade and the annual subscription is billed to the Gold Card in the first billing cycle. Gold must stay active to keep using the card and earning 3%.

benefits.name: Foreign transaction fee (3% for accounts opened on/after July 1, 2026)
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% if you opened the card account before July 1, 2026; 3% of the U.S. dollar amount of each foreign-currency transaction if opened on or after that date
benefits.howToUse: Automatic — pre-July 1, 2026 cardholders are grandfathered with no FX fee for now; anyone approved on or after July 1, 2026 pays the 3% fee on foreign-currency purchases. Conversion uses Visa's exchange rate.

benefits.name: No balance transfer fee
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 transaction fee on balance transfers (APR for transfers is 29.99% variable)
benefits.howToUse: No fee is charged to move a balance; note Finder reports Robinhood does not accept balance transfers onto this card at all, so verify in the app before relying on this. Interest starts accruing immediately with no grace period.

benefits.name: Late payment fee up to $40 (card DOES charge late fees)
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $40 per late payment; returned payment fee also up to $40
benefits.howToUse: Despite launch-era 'no fees' framing, the current terms charge up to $40 for a missed payment; set up autopay in the Robinhood credit card app to avoid it.

benefits.name: Purchase protection / purchase security
benefits.amountDisplay: $1,000 per occurrence, up to $10,000 per cardholder
benefits.howToUse: Covers eligible new purchases against theft or damage shortly after purchase; file a claim through the Visa Signature benefits administrator. Terms and claim windows are in the card's benefits guide.

benefits.name: Extended warranty protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10,000 per occurrence, $50,000 per cardholder
benefits.howToUse: Extends the manufacturer's warranty on eligible items purchased with the card; keep receipts and file claims via the Visa Signature benefits administrator.

benefits.name: Trip cancellation/interruption coverage
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $2,000 per person per trip
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the covered trip with the Gold Card; if a trip is cancelled or cut short for a covered reason, file a claim with the Visa Signature benefits administrator.

benefits.name: Visa Signature travel and assistance benefits
benefits.amountDisplay: Auto rental collision damage waiver (secondary), return protection, roadside dispatch, 24/7 travel and emergency assistance, Visa Signature Concierge, zero liability protection
benefits.howToUse: Pay for the rental or purchase with the card; for assistance or concierge requests, call the number on the back of the card. As of Oct 2025 listings, lounge access is not included (points can be redeemed toward lounge purchases).

benefits.name: Disposable virtual card numbers
benefits.amountDisplay: Unlimited one-time virtual card numbers tied to the account
benefits.howToUse: Generate a new virtual card number in the Robinhood credit card app for each online purchase, subscription, or free trial, and delete it anytime so the primary card number is never exposed.

benefits.name: Family authorized users (any age) with spending controls
benefits.amountDisplay: Add up to five authorized users of any age at no extra cost, with per-user spending limits and instant card lock
benefits.howToUse: In the credit card app, add a family member by name (SSN not required for minors); set a dollar spending limit per user and toggle child-safe controls; track each user's spend and lock a lost card instantly.

benefits.name: Robinhood Gold membership perks bundled with card eligibility
benefits.amountDisplay: 3.6% APY on uninvested brokerage cash (via cash sweep, as of Sep 17, 2026); 3% match on eligible IRA contributions; first $1,000 of margin interest-free; 1% deposit boost on eligible new deposits; Morningstar research and Nasdaq Level II data
benefits.howToUse: All are part of the required Gold membership ($5/month or $50/year) — they activate with your Gold subscription, not the card itself, and are what can make the membership worthwhile beyond the 3% card rate.
